phase1_assignment.objective: Audit generic scientist-agent evidence packaging, reproducibility and handoff mechanisms that preserve observation/inference/uncertainty and exact continuation.

observations.mechanism: EvoScientist validates and stores failed idea directions, but the paper-level memory interface does not specify target-side mechanism or assumption revalidation before reuse
observations.evidence: The primary paper states that ideation-memory retrieval selects top-k items using embedding cosine similarity. IVE marks a proposal failed either when no executable code is found within budget or, after completed experiments, when an LLM-based analysis judges the proposed method worse than baselines; the resulting validation analysis updates ideation memory. The paper text does not define per-record source scope, target assumptions, provenance digests, or a bounded target-side probe as part of retrieval/adoption.
observations.scope: Exact to the published EvoScientist v1 paper description. Absence of fields from the paper text is not proof that unpublished or historical implementation code never carried them.

observations.mechanism: paper-to-current-repository drift is itself a provenance risk for reproducible scientist-agent handoff
observations.evidence: The official EvoScientist repository is active and now exposes a newer observation-memory subsystem. Public code search at the current repository ref surfaced memory files such as EvoScientist/memory/types.py and EvoScientist/memory/observations/tools.py, while exact searches for the paper's IVE phrase and the named mxbai-embed-large model returned no current-code hits. This does not establish that the historical paper implementation lacked those artifacts; it establishes that a handoff must bind claims to a paper/version/ref rather than assuming the current default branch is the evaluated implementation.
observations.scope: Current public repository/search surface versus the March 2026 paper. Historical commit/tag mapping was not completed before control-head drift.

observations.mechanism: newer EvoScientist observation retrieval adds scope/type filtering and a per-task preflight, a stronger retrieval surface than the paper's embedding-only description but without matched scientific-memory revalidation evidence
observations.evidence: The official release notes for v0.1.7 describe search_observations/read_memory, ranked keyword retrieval, scope/type filters, and per-task preflight searches before coding/debugging/research/planning/evaluation. These are useful implementation patterns for reducing blind memory reuse, but the release notes do not provide a matched ablation of target-side mechanism revalidation or establish equivalence with the paper's IVE memory.
observations.scope: Current product observation-memory retrieval only; supporting architecture evidence, not a causal scientific-agent revalidation result.

inferences.proposal: Keep validation-derived failure-memory creation separate from target-side qualification. EvoScientist directly supports creating failure-derived memory, but its published top-k cosine retrieval does not justify skipping mechanism-assumption compatibility or target probes when the receiver context differs.

Add implementation-revision binding to evidence handoff: a paper/evaluation claim must name the exact source revision or artifact identity it was tested against, and a newer default branch is a distinct implementation until equivalence is established.

failure_memory_suite.preservation: read and preserved unchanged; planned prequalification-revocation/policy-revision and evidence-freshness/supersession edits were not started after post-freeze repository-head drift
